title: Spectra Finance — Router Arbitrary External Call Vulnerability Analysis
root_cause: The `KYBER_SWAP(0x12)` command was missing from the `_dispatch()` implementation, allowing arbitrary external calls through the router
steps: ✅ Transfer event emitted: victim → attack contract
other_code: KYBER_SWAP: (address kyberRouter, address tokenIn, uint256 amountIn, address tokenOut, uint256 expectedAmountOut, bytes targetData)
